output_summary: PID, executable identity, CPU/memory and safe owner metadata.

source.source_text: Purpose: bounded process inventory. Input: limit?:1..500, sort?:cpu|memory|pid|name. Output: PID, executable identity, CPU/memory and safe owner metadata. Contract: L0 read_only; scope mac.process.read; target process_set; timeout 5000ms; cap 256KiB; no network/filesystem; process argv/env redacted by policy; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
